summary: Recent changes in the Media Control and Session area involved refining how certain internal files relate to each other, particularly by stopping the inclusion of ModuleLoaderBase.h in WorkerPrivate.h and WorkerScope.h. This adjustment is part of efforts to streamline the code that handles web workers, which are essential for running scripts in the background without interfering with the user interface. While this may seem technical, such optimizations can lead to **improved performance and responsiveness** in media-related features, ensuring a smoother experience when using applications that rely on heavy processing, like streaming services or video calls. _There are no visible changes to user-facing features from this update._
